scope: Fresh complete matrix: six deterministic policies on twenty days and five SA seeds on each day, 220 day-runs.

settings.main_score: Pooled B = 50 * sum(delivered + on_time) / sum(input parcels)
settings.score_a: Pooled completion first, on-time service breaks exact completion ties; SA uses mean seed counts.
settings.sa_random_stream: Dedicated Random(seed), reset once per independent day-run and continued across its dispatches.
settings.sa_aggregation: Pool each seed across days, then mean/range/sample SD across seeds 0–4; never select best seed.
settings.tuning: No implementation or parameter changes before or during this evaluation.
